_meta.name: TWOT
_meta.fullName: Theological Wordbook of the Old Testament
_meta.author: R. Laird Harris, Gleason L. Archer, Jr., Bruce K. Waltke
_meta.description: Theological dictionary showing semantic development of Biblical Hebrew words
_meta.note: Scholarly Tier 2 - Shows theological and semantic development

אהב.theological_meaning: Encompasses both human and divine love. God's love is characterized as covenantal, choosing, and redemptive. The noun אַהֲבָה expresses deep affection.
אהב.semantic_range: love, like, be a friend, beloved

אמן.theological_meaning: Root of 'Amen' - emphasizes reliability and trustworthiness. God is the אֵל אֱמוּנָה (faithful God). Faith (אֱמוּנָה) is trust in God's reliability.

ברא.theological_meaning: Used exclusively of divine creation. Never has an object of material from which something is made - implies creation ex nihilo. Key term in Genesis 1.
ברא.usage_note: Always with God as subject; distinct from עשה (make) and יצר (form)

ברך.theological_meaning: Blessing involves empowerment for success and prosperity. Divine blessing conveys God's favor. Human blessing of God = praise/thanksgiving.

גאל.theological_meaning: The גֹּאֵל redeems property, persons, or blood. God as Israel's גֹּאֵל delivers from Egypt and exile. Messianic significance in redemption theology.

דעת.theological_meaning: Not merely intellectual but experiential/relational. 'Knowledge of God' (דַּעַת אֱלֹהִים) = intimate covenant relationship. Central in Hosea.

חכמה.theological_meaning: Practical skill for living. Divine wisdom personified in Proverbs 8. Fear of the LORD is its beginning. Contrasts with folly.

חן.theological_meaning: Unmerited favor. 'Finding favor in eyes' = gaining acceptance. Foundation for NT concept of grace (charis).

חסד.theological_meaning: Central OT concept for God's covenant faithfulness. Combines love and loyalty. Often paired with אֱמֶת (truth). Untranslatable - includes mercy, grace, loyalty.
חסד.semantic_range: steadfast love, mercy, kindness, loyalty, faithfulness
חסד.usage_note: Key attribute of God (Exodus 34:6); Psalms most frequent location

טהר.theological_meaning: Ritual/moral purity. Clean animals, vessels, persons can approach God. Opposite of טָמֵא (unclean). Levitical system centers on this distinction.

טמא.theological_meaning: Ritual/moral impurity incompatible with God's presence. Sources: death, disease, certain animals, sin. Requires purification rituals.

ישע.theological_meaning: Salvation primarily means deliverance from enemies/danger. God as Savior (מוֹשִׁיעַ). Messianic name יֵשׁוּעַ (Jesus) derives from this root.

כבד.theological_meaning: Connects weight/substance with honor. כָּבוֹד (glory) = God's visible manifestation and intrinsic worth. To honor parents = give them weight/importance.

כפר.theological_meaning: Central sacrificial term. Day of Atonement (יוֹם הַכִּפֻּרִים) centers on this. Means to cover sin, ransom life, propitiate God's wrath.

משיח.theological_meaning: One anointed with oil for office (king, priest, prophet). The Messiah = the ultimate anointed king from David's line. NT 'Christ' = Greek translation.

נביא.theological_meaning: One called to speak for God. Not primarily a foreteller but a forth-teller. Must pass tests of Deuteronomy 13 and 18. Moses = paradigm prophet.

נחם.theological_meaning: Two distinct meanings: 1) comfort/console; 2) repent/change mind. When God 'repents' = responds to changed circumstances (anthropomorphic language).

עון.theological_meaning: Includes sin, guilt, and punishment in single word. The servant bears our עָוֹן (Isaiah 53). Part of confession formula with חֵטְא and פֶּשַׁע.

פשע.theological_meaning: Willful rebellion against authority (human or divine). More severe than חֵטְא (missing mark) or עָוֹן (crookedness). Covenant violation.

צדק.theological_meaning: Conformity to an ethical/moral standard. God's צֶדֶק = his saving acts AND his judgment. Messianic king characterized by righteousness.

קדש.theological_meaning: Fundamental attribute of God - 'set apart,' transcendent, other. Holiness code (Lev 17-26): 'Be holy for I am holy.' Things/people consecrated to God are קָדוֹשׁ.

רחם.theological_meaning: Compassion rooted in motherly love (from רֶחֶם 'womb'). Divine attribute (Exodus 34:6). רַחוּם = 'compassionate.'

שלם.theological_meaning: Wholeness, completeness, well-being. שָׁלוֹם = more than absence of war; total well-being. Peace offerings (שְׁלָמִים) celebrate covenant fellowship.

שמע.theological_meaning: Hearing implies obedience in Hebrew thought. שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל (Hear, O Israel) = listen and obey. God hears (responds to) prayer.
שמע.usage_note: Key verb in Deuteronomy's theology of obedient response

תורה.theological_meaning: From ירה 'to throw/teach.' Not merely legal code but divine instruction for life. The Pentateuch. Central to Jewish faith; loved in Psalm 119.
תורה.usage_note: Torah = God's gracious gift of guidance, not burden
